name: lanovel-extension
description: LANOVEL Chrome Extension - TypeScript & esbuild Modularized

scripts.rollback: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); ['background.js','content.js','manifest.json','remote.js','remote_content.js'].forEach(f => { if(fs.existsSync('legacy_backup/'+f)) fs.copyFileSync('legacy_backup/'+f, f); }); console.log('Successfully rolled back to legacy extension files.');"
